items.source:
Determine whether this filter matches for the class described by
the given metadata.
items.translation: 确定此过滤器是否匹配由给定元数据描述的类型。

items.source: Costin Leau, Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher
items.translation: Costin Leau, Juergen Hoeller, Mark Fisher

items.source: Base interface for type filters using a MetadataReader.
items.translation: 用于基于 MetadataReader 的类型过滤器的基础接口。

items.source: IOException - in case of I/O failure when reading metadata
items.translation: IOException - 读取元数据时发生 I/O 故障的情况

items.source: metadataReader - the metadata reader for the target class
items.translation: metadataReader - 目标类的元数据读取器

items.source: metadataReaderFactory - a factory for obtaining metadata readers for other classes (such as superclasses and interfaces)
items.translation: metadataReaderFactory - 用于获取其他类（如超类和接口）的元数据读取器的工厂

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。
